## Function

```{r}
knn_tuning = function(row){
  
  if (row["balanced"] == FALSE){
    trainingdata = add_observations(whaledf = data,
                                start_time = 0,
                                end_time = 100,
                                num_time_steps = row["num_time_steps"], 
                                numcep = 12,
                                step_size = 0.05)
  }
  
  if (row["balanced"] == TRUE){
    trainingdata = add_observations(whaledf = data,
                                start_time = 0,
                                end_time = 100,
                                num_time_steps = row["num_time_steps"], 
                                numcep = 12,
                                step_size = 0.05)

    numnegatives = nrow(trainingdata %>% filter(Humpback == 0))
  
    # taking row numbers of positive observations
  
    trainingpositives = trainingdata %>% filter(Humpback == 1)
  
    #trainingpositives[sample(c(1:nrow(trainingpositives)), size = numnegatives),]
  
  
    trainingdata = rbind(trainingdata %>% filter(Humpback == 0),
                                trainingpositives[sample(c(1:nrow(trainingpositives)), size = numnegatives),]
                                    )
  }
  
  testingdata = add_observations(whaledf = data,
                                start_time = 1000,
                                end_time = 1200,
                                num_time_steps = row["num_time_steps"], 
                                numcep = 12,
                                step_size = 0.05)
  
  training_cvs = vfold_cv(trainingdata, v = 10)
  
  
  #creating model
  knn_mod1 = nearest_neighbor(neighbors = row["num_neighbors"]) %>%
    set_engine("kknn") %>%
    set_mode("classification")
  
  #creating recipe
  knnrecipe_1 = recipe(Humpback ~ ., data = trainingdata) %>%
    step_rm(Time_Start, Time_End) %>%
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
    step_dummy(all_factor_predictors())
  
  
  #creating workflow
  knnworkflow_1 = workflow() %>% 
    add_recipe(knnrecipe_1) %>% 
    add_model(knn_mod1)
  
  #fitting model
  knnfit_1 = knnworkflow_1 %>% fit(trainingdata) 

  
  knnpredictions = testingdata %>%
  mutate(
    preds = predict(knnfit_1, testingdata)$.pred_class
  ) %>% dplyr::select(Time_Start, Time_End, preds, Humpback)

  
  print(knnpredictions)
  
  knnwindowpredictions = testing_eval_windows(knnpredictions, 
                                             length = row["agg_wind_length"], 
                                             threshold = row["prop_threshold"])
  
  knnwindowpredictions
  
  # knnwindowpredictions %>%
  #   conf_mat(truth = Humpback,
  #            estimate = prediction)
  
  
  if (nrow(knnwindowpredictions %>% filter(prediction == 1))== 0 | 
      nrow(knnwindowpredictions %>% filter(prediction == 0)) == 0){
    window_recall = -1
    window_precision = -1
    window_F1 = -1
    
  } else {
    window_recall = knnwindowpredictions %>% 
      recall(truth = Humpback, estimate = prediction, event_level = 'second') %>%
      select(.estimate) %>% pull()
    
    window_precision = knnwindowpredictions %>% 
      precision(truth = Humpback, estimate = prediction, event_level = 'second') %>%
      select(.estimate) %>% pull()
    
    window_F1 = (2 * window_recall * window_precision)/(window_recall + window_precision)
  
  
  }
 
  
  manual_annotations = read_excel(here::here("TrainingData", "AW", "AWhb.xlsx"))

  individual_calls = custom_denominator(manual_annotations, knnpredictions,
                   pred_start_time = min(knnpredictions$Time_Start), 
                   pred_end_time = max(knnpredictions$Time_End), 
                   threshold = 0.5)
  
  output = c(row, 
             "Recall" = window_recall, 
             "Precision" = window_precision,
             "F1" = window_F1,  
             "proportion of calls detected" = sum(individual_calls$prediction == 1)/nrow(individual_calls))
  print(class(output))
  return(output)
}

#                      prop_threshold = 0.5, balanced = TRUE)



```


```{r}
grid = vec_expand_grid(num_time_steps = c(40), 
                       num_neighbors = c(25), 
                      agg_wind_length = c(5), 
                     prop_threshold = c(0.5), 
                     balanced = c(FALSE))


grid = vec_expand_grid(num_time_steps = c(20, 40), 
                       num_neighbors = c(100), 
                      agg_wind_length = c(10), 
                     prop_threshold = c(0.5), 
                     balanced = c(FALSE))

# unbalanced data appears to be better

result = apply(grid, MARGIN = 1, FUN = knn_tuning)
data.frame(t(result)) %>% arrange(desc(Recall))

```
